description: This file contains FastAPI route definitions for handling orders in a food delivery backend. Includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, paying, and advancing order statuses, along with internal helper functions.

methods.name: tuple[float,float] _fees_for(subtotal: float)
methods.description: Calculates delivery and service fees based on subtotal.

methods.name: None _add_order_event(conn: Any, order_id: int, status: str, message: str, meta: dict | None = None)
methods.description: Inserts an event log entry for a specific order.

methods.name: None _touch_order_updated(conn: Any, order_id: int)
methods.description: Updates the order's updated_at timestamp to now.

methods.name: Order create_order(payload: CreateOrderRequest, user: dict | None = Depends(get_current_user_optional))
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new order with items, calculating fees, and updating order lifecycle.

methods.name: list[Order] list_orders(user: dict | None = Depends(get_current_user_optional))
methods.description: API endpoint to list orders for the current user; returns empty if unauthenticated.

methods.name: OrderWithItems get_order(order_id: int, user: dict | None = Depends(get_current_user_optional))
methods.description: API to retrieve a specific order and its items, with ownership validation.

methods.name: PaymentResponse pay_order(order_id: int, payload: PaymentRequest)
methods.description: Simulates payment process, updating order status to 'preparing'.

methods.name: dict advance_order(order_id: int)
methods.description: Moves an order to the next status in its lifecycle.

ctags.name: _add_order_event
ctags.pattern: /^def _add_order_event(conn: Any, order_id: int, status: str, message: str, meta: dict | None = No/
ctags.signature: (conn: Any, order_id: int, status: str, message: str, meta: dict | None = None)

ctags.name: create_order
ctags.pattern: /^def create_order(payload: CreateOrderRequest, user: dict | None = Depends(get_current_user_optio/

ctags.name: get_order
ctags.pattern: /^def get_order(order_id: int, user: dict | None = Depends(get_current_user_optional)) -> OrderWit/
